description: Enhance driver-app navigation from current 4 tabs (Home, Trips, Earnings, Profile) to industry-standard 5 tabs (Home, Earnings, Activity, Notifications, Account). Currently has Home/Trips/Earnings/Profile. Target: add Notifications tab, rename Trips to Activity, rename Profile to Account, and ensure all driver workflows (trip requests, active trips, navigation, rating) are properly integrated.
steps: Read apps/driver-app/src/navigation/MainNavigator.tsx to understand current 4-tab structure (Home, Trips, Earnings, Profile)
Update apps/driver-app/src/navigation/MainNavigator.tsx to reorder tabs: Home, Earnings, Activity (rename from Trips), Notifications (new), Account (rename from Profile)

Create apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/NotificationsScreen.tsx for driver notifications: new trip requests, document approval/expiry reminders, payment/payout updates, service announcements, account/safety alerts. Use list with unread indicators
Rename tab labels in apps/driver-app/src/navigation/MainNavigator.tsx: 'Trips' → 'Activity', 'Profile' → 'Account'. Update icon for Activity to 'map-marker-path', Account to 'account-circle'

Update apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/ProfileScreen.tsx content to match industry Account pattern: add sections for Vehicle Registration, Driving License, Required Documents, Verification Status, Preferences, Support, Safety, Sign Out. Preserve existing VehicleInfo and Settings links

Update apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/TripsScreen.tsx to emphasize it as Activity history: show completed/cancelled rides, routes, distances, passenger ratings, dispute details. Add filter tabs (All/Completed/Cancelled)

Add i18n keys to apps/driver-app/src/i18n/locales/en.json and sw.json: tab_activity (en: 'Activity', sw: 'Shughuli'), tab_notifications (en: 'Notifications', sw: 'Arifa'), tab_account (en: 'Account', sw: 'Akaunti'), notifications_title (en: 'Notifications', sw: 'Arifa'), no_notifications (en: 'No notifications', sw: 'Hakuna arifa'), mark_all_read (en: 'Mark all read', sw: 'Weka yote kusoma'), account_title (en: 'Account', sw: 'Akaunti'), vehicle_registration (en: 'Vehicle Registration', sw: 'Usajili wa Gari'), driving_license (en: 'Driving License', sw: 'Leseni ya Udereva'), required_documents (en: 'Required Documents', sw: 'Hati Zinazohitajika'), verification_status (en: 'Verification Status', sw: 'Hali ya Uthibitisho')
Update the HomeStack in MainNavigator.tsx to ensure ActiveTrip, TripDetails, Navigation, and RatePassenger screens remain accessible from Home tab's trip workflow
Verify that driver online/offline toggle, trip request acceptance, active trip navigation, and trip completion flows remain intact after tab restructuring
acceptance_criteria: Driver app displays 5 bottom tabs: Home, Earnings, Activity, Notifications, Account in that order
Home tab shows online/offline toggle, today's earnings, total trips, rating, acceptance rate, and new trip requests
Earnings tab shows daily/weekly/monthly earnings, fare breakdown, bonuses, payout history
Activity tab shows completed/cancelled rides with filters, routes, distances, passenger ratings
Notifications tab displays driver-specific notifications (trip requests, document reminders, payment updates, service announcements, safety alerts) with read/unread states
Account tab shows profile, vehicle registration, driving license, required documents, verification status, support, safety, sign out
All existing driver workflows (accept trip, navigate to pickup, start trip, navigate to destination, complete trip, rate passenger) work without regression
i18n works in both English and Swahili for all navigation labels and new screen content
Tab icons match industry standards (home, cash-multiple, map-marker-path, bell, account-circle)
verification: Run: cd apps/driver-app && npx expo start
Open in iOS Simulator or Android Emulator
Verify 5 bottom tabs appear: Home, Earnings, Activity, Notifications, Account
Tap each tab and verify correct screen loads
On Home tab, toggle online/offline and verify status changes
Verify trip request UI appears when tapping 'Accept' from HomeScreen (may need backend or mock)
Navigate to Earnings tab and verify daily/weekly/monthly earnings display with breakdown
Navigate to Activity tab and verify trip history with filters (All/Completed/Cancelled)
Navigate to Notifications tab and verify notifications list appears (mock data OK if no real notifications)
Navigate to Account tab and verify all sections are present: profile info, vehicle registration link, driving license, required documents, verification status, support, safety, sign out
Tap Settings in Account tab and verify SettingsScreen opens
Change language to Swahili and verify all tab labels and screen titles update to Swahili
Change back to English and verify labels revert to English
